verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client. A terminal could plausibly offer an isolated test environment, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no sandbox or test environment, dry-run mode, or production-data isolation of its own. Connecting to Codespaces, GitPod, or user-chosen servers is a user-side arrangement, not a product sandbox capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
